metadata.description: Plugins for producing audio and image with AI tools that do not expose a public API

plugins.name: google-flow
plugins.description: Google Labs Flow: read and drive your own applets, generate assets in batch, and upscale for free. Generic core; project-specific details live in packs/.

plugins.name: flow-music
plugins.description: Google Flow Music: account and credits, song catalog, and stem download —bass included— via the API. MCP server, authentication precondition, and behavior guide.

plugins.name: suno
plugins.description: Suno done right: Studio 2.0 (multitrack DAW and WAV stem export), browser-driven operation, and local verification of what gets downloaded. The MCP never touches the network by design.
